proposed.label: Treats population growth as simple growth
proposed.description: Adds the same amount every year, P(1 + i x n), instead of multiplying by (1 + i) each year, so growth is not compounded.

proposed.label: Swaps the rate and the number of years
proposed.description: Uses the number of years as the percentage and the percentage as the exponent, because both are just numbers in the question.

proposed.label: Uses the rate as a whole number
proposed.description: Puts the growth rate into the formula as r (for example 1 + 5) instead of r/100 (1 + 0.05), so the percentage is never converted to a fraction.
